sourceEnglish.advancements.bismuth_get.title: Deep Space 33
sourceEnglish.advancements.bismuth_get.descr: Obtain Bismuth from an outcrop or geode. (Not all worlds will generate Bismuth.)

sourceEnglish.advancements.bloodstone_get.title: Black Ichor
sourceEnglish.advancements.bloodstone_get.descr: Obtain polished Bloodstone. (Not all worlds will generate Bloodstone.)

sourceEnglish.advancements.breather_sponge_get.title: I NEEEEED IIIIIIIIIT.
sourceEnglish.advancements.breather_sponge_get.descr: Use a Straw to absorb oxygen from a Breather Sponge.

sourceEnglish.advancements.carborundum_get.title: One Giant Leap
sourceEnglish.advancements.carborundum_get.descr: Equip a full set of Carborundum Armor.

sourceEnglish.advancements.cauldron_get.title: You can has Mithral :)
sourceEnglish.advancements.cauldron_get.descr: Grab a Trilobite with a Cauldron and use it to combine a stack of Spice, or to dissolve a single node into a lower tier.

sourceEnglish.advancements.climbing_pick_get.title: Getting Over It
sourceEnglish.advancements.climbing_pick_get.descr: Obtain a Climbing Pick, found in Glaciation bases.

sourceEnglish.advancements.cobalt_heights_get.title: The Cobalt Heights
sourceEnglish.advancements.cobalt_heights_get.descr: The air crackles with static electricity...

sourceEnglish.advancements.drinking_straw_get.title: Slonk it Silly Style
sourceEnglish.advancements.drinking_straw_get.descr: Craft a Silly Straw, because it's sillyyyy!!!

sourceEnglish.advancements.garden_plant_get.title: Green Thumb
sourceEnglish.advancements.garden_plant_get.descr: Grow a seed in a pot

sourceEnglish.advancements.herald_get.title: No Sound, No Memory
sourceEnglish.advancements.herald_get.descr: Feed a Herald until it blooms and take it's key

sourceEnglish.advancements.keystone_get.title: Out of This World
sourceEnglish.advancements.keystone_get.descr: Retrieve the Keystone from a mysterious sponsor, and place it in a 3x3 platform of obsidian...

sourceEnglish.advancements.malachite_get.title: Enderite
sourceEnglish.advancements.malachite_get.descr: Obtain Malachite from an outcrop or geode.

sourceEnglish.advancements.siibol_get.title: Sick Cloud, Bro
sourceEnglish.advancements.siibol_get.descr: Scoop up a Siibol with a bucket.

sourceEnglish.advancements.torpedo_consume_get.title: Go Big or go Home!
sourceEnglish.advancements.torpedo_consume_get.descr: Put yours and your friends' lives on the line and consume a Raw Torpedo. (Cuz what if it's actually super yummy??????)

sourceEnglish.advancements.zap_gauntlet_get.title: Magnify

sourceEnglish.advancements.zenith_get.title: Zenith would be proud.
sourceEnglish.advancements.zenith_get.descr: Aquire a full set of Zenith armor.
